title: Relationship Between the Lactate and Ventilatory Thresholds During Prolonged Exercise
claims: The anaerobic threshold is commonly estimated either from blood lactate or from ventilatory gases.
The relationship between the lactate and ventilatory thresholds is not conclusive.
The two thresholds measure different physiological signals, so they should not be treated as equivalent.
The individual anaerobic threshold is described as an intensity that can be sustained for at least about 50 minutes in trained subjects.
